cards.question: Conductor
cards.answer: A material that allows electric current to flow through it easily

cards.question: Insulator
cards.answer: A material that does not allow electric current to flow through it easily

cards.question: Current
cards.answer: The rate of flow of electric charge

cards.question: Potential difference
cards.answer: The energy transferred per unit charge between two points

cards.question: Resistance
cards.answer: How much a component opposes the flow of current

cards.question: Series circuit
cards.answer: A circuit with only one loop

cards.question: Parallel circuit
cards.answer: A circuit with more than one loop

cards.question: Ammeter
cards.answer: A meter that measures current, connected in series
